subject: POC playtest runbook + data onboarding
messages:
From: Tom Wilson <tom.wilson@acme.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: POC kickoff / sample payloads for playtest

Hi Soojin / Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Wed like to move to a short playtest POC to validate routing and the low-latency paths you showed. High level ask: a 90–120 minute hands-on session where we walk through: prompt review, routing decisions, and a short load run to validate end-to-end throughput.

Two proposed slots: Tue Nov 17 10:00–12:00 PT or Wed Nov 18 14:00–16:00 PT. Either works for us — tell us what you prefer.

I attached a small sample CSV (acme-sample-claims.csv) that contains representative customer claims. We did a first-pass redact but there are still columns with potentially sensitive tokens (policy numbers, notes). Can you share your redaction checklist and any preferred format for test prompts / eval sets so we can prep before the session?

Also: Sarah (cc) will be the technical lead on our side; shell handle upload.

Thanks,
Tom Wilson
Sr. Product Manager — Acme Claims
Attachment: acme-sample-claims.csv (CSV, 12k rows, first-pass redaction)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Wilson <tom.wilson@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff / sample payloads for playtest

Tom — great to hear and thanks for the file. We can run the session as you described.

Quick answers:
- We prefer Nov 18 10:00–12:00 PT (allows us to include a short warm-up for routing config).
- For the hands-on portion well do — in order: prompt review (30m), routing & policy checks (30m), load verification (30m), quick evaluation & next steps (30m).
- Redaction checklist: Im attaching a compact PDF with our redaction guidance (redaction-guidelines.pdf). Key things we look for: remove direct PII (names, SSNs), tokenized IDs (policy numbers) should be replaced with synthetic tokens (POLY_XXXX), and free-text notes should be truncated to 200 chars or moved into a separate field.

Pre-session items (please):
1) Upload a sanitized CSV to the shared Drive or an S3 presigned link by EOD Nov 16.
2) Provide a 20–30 item set of representative prompts (CSV or plain text) you want validated during the session.
3) Flag any success metrics (e.g., latency target 200ms p50; routing accuracy for fraud prompt >90%).

Im attaching a short PoC playtest runbook (poc-playtest-runbook-v1.md) that covers the exact steps well run and an example eval set format. Marcus will follow up with a calendar invite and the engineering attendees.

— Soojin
Solutions Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redaction-guidelines.pdf; poc-playtest-runbook-v1.md

From: Tom Wilson <tom.wilson@acme.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff / sample payloads for playtest

Thanks Soojin — I uploaded the sanitized CSV and a prompts file to the Drive folder you linked: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c.

What I included:
- acme-sample-claims_sanitized_v1.csv (we replaced names with client_#### and policy numbers with POLY_####)
- acme-prompts_playtest.txt (25 prompts across claims triage / routing / customer messaging)
- readme.txt describing the columns and a quick inventory of free-text lengths.

Question: in the runbook you mention 2x routing variants (fast path vs cost path). Do you want both variants present in the CSV as separate columns (e.g., prompt_type, preferred_route) or should we rely on prompt content and let Redwood route dynamically? We can add a column if thats easier to orchestrate.

Tom

Attachment: drive upload confirmation (list of files)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Wilson <tom.wilson@acme.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Scheduling: confirmed slot and pre-run checklist

Tom / Sarah — thanks for the upload and clear readme. Well take Nov 18 10:00–12:00 PT as confirmed and Ill send the calendar invite in a separate email. A couple quick operational notes: 

- Routing variants: please add a column preferred_route with values {fast,cost,auto}. Well honor preferred_route for one run and then run the dynamic auto-routing to compare metrics.
- Load profile: we plan a short 10-minute ramp to 50 RPS peak then a 10-minute hold. That should surface queuing and KV cache behavior. If you expect higher concurrency let us know now.
- Credentials: for the private demo youll need a token for the sandbox account; I added steps to the runbook. If youre using our hosted API well provide a scoped key.

Marissa, can you add the engineering attendees and include the fallback playbook in the invite?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Wilson <tom.wilson@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Final prep: Nov 18 playtest — checklist & calendar

Tom / Sarah —

All set on our side. Calendar invite sent for Nov 18 10:00–12:00 PT (two-hour block) and I added a readout slot on Nov 19 11:00–11:30 PT for results + next steps. Please confirm you received both.

Final pre-session checklist (quick):
- [ ] Confirm sanitized CSV in Drive and tag the column preferred_route (fast/cost/auto).
- [ ] Drop 2030 priority prompts into acme-prompts_playtest.txt (we have 25; pick the most impactful subset).
- [ ] Confirm latency target and routes to evaluate (reply with explicit numbers).
- [ ] Provide the sandbox token method (we prefer a scoped API key; Marcus will send the instructions).

Attachments included in invite: poc-playtest-runbook-v1.md; redaction-guidelines.pdf. Well also reference the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c.

If you can reply to confirm the CSV is the sanitized version and that preferred_route column is present, well finalize scripts and test harness tomorrow. Looking forward to it.

— Soojin
Solutions Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: calendar-invite.ics (stub)
